break: Break {case_id} is open as of {as_of}. Read it and pick its resolution from its kind's list.
reroute: Rail health alert on corridor {corridor} as of {as_of}: {from_provider} on {from_rail} is failing. Read the corridor's rail health and draft a reroute of that pair's payouts for a person to approve, or a hold if no healthy provider exists.
rfi: RFI case {case_id} is in review as of {as_of}. Read the case and the end user's identity record and answer it with one action.
stuck: Payout {attempt_id} is still in our queue as of {as_of}. Decide whether it is late against its own provider and rail's baseline, and flag it.
